data.narrative:
Biobot Analytics is a Series B-stage biotech company that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparison universe of eight private peers in biotech and health, including Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), alongside three public biotech comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two valuation methods are applicable here. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $76M based on the $40M total raised proxy. The peer-median method yields $3.5B, derived from the median valuation of the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Biobot's revenue is not on file, limiting the utility of the 9.2x P/S median observed across public biotech peers.

The triangulation of these two methods produces a valuation range of $65M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. This wide dispersion reflects the acute uncertainty inherent in early-stage biotech valuation: the peer set spans more than a 19x range, and stage-progression methodology significantly underweights the peer-median result. Key uncertainties center on revenue visibility, clinical or commercial validation milestones, and the true comparability of Biobot's stage and business model to the Series C-heavy peer set.
